title: US Treasury Triples Debt Buyback To Stem The Recent Rise in Borrowing Costs
title_cn: 美国财政部将债务回购增加三倍以遏制近期借贷成本上升
summary: The US Treasury tripled the initial size of its buyback of longer-dated government debt, in an announcement that was met with initial disappointment by investors.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rollins Says ‘No’ for Now to Potential Governor, Senate Run
title_cn: 罗林斯暂时对潜在州长、参议院竞选说“不”
summary: Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins, when asked whether she’d consider running for Texas governor or a Senate seat, said she is focused on her current job.
